name: Milwaukee Cubing Mania 2024
information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://worldcubeassociation.org/regulations). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf). This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association.](https://www.midwestcubing.org/) NO outside food or beverages are allowed in the venue. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcll0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c5462feacf32808de5791361d7ec2621bbee11e5/image.png)
